messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High p99 latency detected for tenant 'novaedge' on /v1/stream (p99=4.8s, SLO=2.0s). Streaming stalls reported. Auto-pages sent (7 recipients). dashboard: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/1819876543

alice: i'm oncall, grabbing dashboards + logs. assigning triage.

bob: i'm jumping in. quick check — p95 ~1.3s, p99 ~4.8s for novaedge in us-west-2. no 5xx, mostly long tail/streaming stalls. concurrency spiked ~3x around 18:00.

erin: support note: customer says sessions frequently stall around token ~120-140 while streaming, client shows keepalive but no tokens.

dave: novaedge eng: they run a nightly batch that fans out lots of templated prompts + long JSON blobs. said they pushed a template change ~3h ago.

carol: runtime: possible kvcache thrash + prefix fanout. recent routing tweak to prefer pooled nodes went live ~2h ago — could be related.

frank: assign owners: bob (oncall-sre) + carol (runtime eng). alice coordinate comms/handoff.

alice: handoff to bob at 1819876543. immediate plan:
1) confirm per-tenant kvcache hit rate and evictions
2) check per-node streaming backlog and queues
3) try routing novaedge to isolated capacity pool
4) consider throttling per-connection concurrency / enabling prefix-sticky sessions

bob: running queries now:
```
# get tenant tail latency
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(streaming_response_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, tenant))
```
Result: novaedge p99=4.8s (5m window).

bob: kubectl exec -it streamer-abc -c exporter -- curl localhost:9100/metrics | grep novaedge
pod streamer-abc: CPU 68%, GPU util 74%; backlog queues show 30-40 active streams per worker.

carol: checking kvcache metrics:
```
SELECT tenant, hit_rate, evictions/min FROM kvcache_metrics WHERE tenant='novaedge' AND time > now() - 10m
```
hit_rate=22%, evictions/min=85 -> heavy thrash.

bob: mitigation step 1: route novaedge to isolation pool 'iso-2' to reduce noisy neighbor effects. running: `/infra route-tenant --tenant novaedge --pool iso-2`
incident-bot: route-tenant executed by deploy-bot at 1819877260 (manifest applied).

alice: after routing p99 dropped to ~2.1s for routed sessions but still above SLO. p95 unchanged ~1.2s. stalls still observed intermittently. ~40% of sessions still hitting old pool during graceful drain.

carol: hypothesis: long-prefix prompts causing frequent KV cache evictions and asynchronous flush delays in streaming encoder. two levers: increase streaming flush threshold and enable prefix-sticky KV for novaedge (avoid cross-tenant eviction).

bob: rapid config change: limit per-connection multiplexing to reduce hotpath contention: `/infra set-tenant-config novaedge max_concurrency=2` (applied).

erin: reached out to customer for example prompts. they sent a sanitized sample: starts with a ~900-token JSON payload + repeated instruction templates. they confirm the new template was rolled earlier tonight.

dave: got sample. it's very repetitive and triggers long common prefixes across many sessions -> likely kvcache churn. sending to carol for eval.

carol: starting a canary: enable prefix-sticky (experimental) for 10% of novaedge sessions and increase flush threshold for streaming encoder on those sessions. canary start at 1819877920.
incident-bot: canary rollout 10% started at 1819877920 (change-id canary-4827).

bob: monitoring canary vs baseline: canary p99 ~1.6s, baseline ~2.0s. overall p99 down to 1.9s. good signal.

alice: update: affected request fraction dropped from ~58% -> ~18%. customer impact reduced but SLO not fully met yet for subset. keeping canary and watching for 45m.

frank: note for followup: need automated detection for long-prefix-induced KV thrash and auto-migrate noisy tenants to isolated pools. also consider sticky-kv default for tenants above X prompt length.

carol: opened PR to persist prefix-sticky config and bump streaming flush thresholds; PR #4827: https://git/repo/pull/4827 (includes revert instructions).

erin: customer reports stalls mostly resolved in canary group and asks for permanent fix timeline.

dave: proposing a two-week ETA for hardened fix + option to migrate novaedge to Dedicated capacity (separate proposal). customer expressed preference for permanent fix first.

bob: observed p99 now ~1.8s across novaedge after canary ramp; local metrics show queued task reduction and higher kvcache hit_rate in canary sessions.

alice: action items:
- continue canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% if stable (45m checks between ramps)
- schedule postmortem + customer sync within 48h
- add targeted alert for high eviction rate per-tenant kvcache
- engineering followup for auto-migration knobs

erin: I'll coordinate customer comms and set expectations.

bob: final note before standby: p99 trending down, removing paging for now but keeping incident channel open for 2h watch. last_message_ts 1819878643

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated for now. Followup required: PM/ENG postmortem + infra task.
